title: AB1589 (2025-2026 Regular): Firearms: silencers.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check, California); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov text (Amended 2026-05-20, via LegiScan getBillText)
provenance.note: Amended in Assembly May 20, 2026. The bill strikes the period after "duties" in subdivision (c) and adds the condition that the silencer and rifle be agency-owned. Subdivisions (a), (b), (d) are unchanged existing law.

operative_text: Section 33415 (Penal Code): (c) The possession of silencers by level I reserve peace officers, as defined in paragraph (1) of subdivision (a) of Section 832.6, who are deputized or appointed by an agency listed in Section 830.1, when on duty and when the use of silencers is authorized by the agency and is within the course and scope of their duties, if the silencer is owned by a law enforcement agency, and affixed to a rifle owned by a law enforcement agency, listed in Section 830.1.
